# UDP. The bridge owns the link to the flight software and all framing, so this plugin needs no protocol
# stack of its own.

VARIABLE_DESCRIPTION "COSMOS target name for the F Prime deployment"
VARIABLE fprime_bridge_host host.docker.internal
VARIABLE_DESCRIPTION "Host running fprime-comm-bridge as seen from the COSMOS containers"
VARIABLE fprime_bridge_port 50001
VARIABLE_DESCRIPTION "UDP port on which fprime-comm-bridge receives commands (its --udp-fast-recv-port)"
VARIABLE fprime_cosmos_port 50000
VARIABLE_DESCRIPTION "UDP port on which COSMOS receives telemetry (the bridge's --udp-fast-send-port)"
